thread:
anna: Heads up — canary pods in eu-central are failing to pull `registry.aws.redwood/redwood-worker:canary-2026-03` (kube error: `manifest unknown`).
liam: Any recent publish logs?
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] publish rejected: provenance check failed for tag `canary-2026-03` -> attestation TTL exceeded (attestation: 2025-10-30T22:01:12Z).
anna: Ugh, I think lifecycle rules removed the tag after 30d. Digest might still exist but tag unbound.
ops-oncall: If digest exists we can retag and trigger a publish, but deploy-bot will block until attestation refreshed. Manual cosign is allowed with release lead approval.
harper: We have the digest cached in CI artifacts: `sha256:abc123def456ghi789...` (from build 2026-02-12). Could we re-sign that digest?
liam: Automated re-signing from CI is blocked due to key rotation policy — only ops can do KMS signing.
ops-oncall: I can do a manual cosign if release lead signs off. But risk: manual signing needs audit trail. Alternative: roll the canary back to previous stable digest and queue a republish job.
anna: Rollback now makes sense — we don't want user-facing canary timeouts. Which stable digest?
liam: Stable @prod: `sha256:111aaa222bbb333ccc444ddd555eee666fff777ggg888hhh999iii000jjj` deployed 2026-01-08.
ops-oncall: I'll trigger rollback job. Also opening INC-5421 to track republish + attestation refresh.
anna: Rolling: `kubectl set image deploy/worker worker=registry.aws.redwood/redwood-worker@sha256:111aaa2...`
anna: Pods restarting, image pull OK. Can confirm traffic is routing to previous canary.
harper: I'll prep the republish runbook: steps include verifying digest presence, request release lead sign-off (REQ-501), ops manual cosign via KMS, re-tagging `canary-2026-03`, then let deploy-bot re-attempt publish.
liam: Suggestion: change infra lifecycle to preserve tags that match `canary-*` for 60 days or retain any manifest with a valid attestation. Opened INFRA-1294 to propose that.
ops-oncall: Filed INFRA-1294 and attached rollback/playbook. Marking INC-5421 as blocker for automated canary rollout until republish done.
anna: Thanks. We'll leave canary pinned to stable digest until republish completes. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback completed for `worker` in eu-central — status: success.
